name: TeslaMate
description_en: A powerful data logger for Tesla vehicles. `MIT` `Elixir/Docker`
description: A self-hosted data logger for your Tesla  🚘 [main maintainer=@JakobLichterfeld]
readme_preview:
A powerful, self-hosted data logger for your Tesla.

- Written in **[Elixir](https://elixir-lang.org/)** - Data is stored in a **Postgres** database - Visualization and data analysis with **Grafana** - Vehicle data is published to a local **[MQTT](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MQTT)** Broker

> [!CAUTION] > **Use Official Versions Only**
